solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0310d998b3628933ad4c19c4a3079b1283ea0c3032b53a614f577c713630d488.png] 

The shaded region represents the total number of people who are Students but neither Artists nor Athletes.

So, the total number of people who are Students but neither Artists nor Athletes = 60

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
